map_info.name: QFEP Phase Chamber
map_info.description: Seven phase stations arranged in a circle. F_order (crystal in jar), oscillation (pendulum mid-swing), E_entropy (flask reacting over bunsen), lambda_edge (vacuum chamber at over-pressure), integration (scales balanced), relation (kaleidoscope), synthesis (autoclave). Walking the circle IS walking the phase diagram. Built 2026-05-22 as the second algorithm-trajectory chamber; sister to Turing_Machine_Lab.

learning_objectives: Visit the seven QFEP phases as physical stations in a circle
Read each prop's state as the phase it embodies
Walk the chamber once = walk the phase diagram once
